coastal.title: Investigators called in after multiple fires ignite in wildfire-ravaged Boston Bar
coastal.description: A spokesperson with the Fraser Valley Regional District would not say how many fires were burning or if a suspected arsonist is at work.

coastal.title: Wildfire north of Sooke, B.C., burning out of control
coastal.description: The Mount Jack Wildfire on Southern Vancouver Island is still classified as out of control by the B.C. Wildfire Services. It was discovered on Sept. 20 and has grown to at least 210 hectares in size. Part of The Galloping Goose Trail has been closed as precaution.

kamloops.title: ‘God cleaned the slate’: Ashes pave the road to recovery after B.C. wildfires
kamloops.description: Joel Patan says his "life is ashes" now, as he sifts the ruins of his home that was incinerated last month, along with most structures in the small community of Faulder.

all.title: Using a bot to help burn more fuel, more often
all.description: Burn Bot is large, tank-like vehicle that wants to solve the most troubling of fuel mitigation questions – how can you manage more area, across all sorts of terrain, in all sorts of weather, at all times of the year, without overtaxing or endangering local crews, and without smothering communities with smoke? all.title: Canada’s largest fire detector acquires US wildfire business despite barriers
all.description: Wildfire detection company SenseNet, Canada’s largest wildfire detection operator, recently announced the acquisition of N5 Sensors‘ wildfire-related assets, a semiconductor producer in the United States, despite the company’s recent failure in a federal audit and the two nations being in the middle of a trade war.
